title: Procurement, Supply, Installation, Testing & Commissioning Of Asset Performance Management System (APMS) As Per PPMC Specification No. DS-01:2026 On Turnkey Basis
scope_summary: This tender seeks a contractor for the procurement, supply, installation, testing, and commissioning of an Asset Performance Management System (APMS) on a turnkey basis, adhering to PPMC specification No. DS-01:2026. The system aims to enhance operational efficiency and equipment health monitoring within the power sector.

title: Supply and Installation of Asset Performance Management System for Pole Mounted Distribution Transformers
scope_summary: Sukkur Electric Power Company (SEPCO) is inviting bids for the procurement, supply, installation, testing, and commissioning of an Asset Performance Management System (APMS) specifically for Pole Mounted Distribution Transformers. This aims to improve the monitoring and management of critical distribution assets.

title: 3D Laser Scanning of Heritage Sites in Velika Hoča/Hoçë e Madhe and Letnicë/Letnica in Kosovo
scope_summary: This tender seeks services for 3D digital documentation of heritage assets in two villages in Kosovo, Velika Hoča/Hoçë e Madhe and Letnicë/Letnica. The scope also includes a detailed condition survey of the historic Micić winery for future restoration.
